title: Istio
subtitle: A service mesh that secures and shapes service-to-service traffic.

tiles.label: istiod
tiles.says: istiod converts mesh resources into proxy configuration.
tiles.detail: One control process distributes xDS configuration and certificates to every proxy, so policy changes reach the fleet in seconds.

tiles.label: Workload identity
tiles.says: Every workload receives a short-lived certificate.
tiles.detail: SPIFFE-style identities rotate automatically, giving cryptographic service identity without manual certificate work.

tiles.label: Service discovery
tiles.says: Istio learns endpoints from the platform registry.
tiles.detail: Proxies track pod changes in real time, so routing follows deployments automatically.

tiles.label: Envoy sidecars
tiles.says: Envoy proxies intercept and manage every call.
tiles.detail: Retries, timeouts, load balancing and telemetry happen beside each workload, so applications stay free of networking code.

tiles.label: Mutual TLS
tiles.says: The mesh encrypts and authenticates service traffic by default.
tiles.detail: Strict mTLS mode rejects plaintext, giving zero-trust networking and compliance evidence without code changes.

tiles.label: Ingress gateway
tiles.says: Gateways admit external traffic into the mesh.
tiles.detail: A managed Envoy at the edge applies the same routing and security model to inbound requests.

tiles.label: VirtualService
tiles.detail: Match headers and paths, split weights, add retries or inject faults. Canary releases become a configuration change.

tiles.label: DestinationRule
tiles.says: DestinationRule defines subsets and connection policy.
tiles.detail: Subsets by label, load balancing, pools and outlier detection protect services from cascading failure.

tiles.label: Authorization
tiles.says: AuthorizationPolicy allows or denies by identity.
tiles.detail: Rules based on service identity, method and path enforce least privilege between services.

declarations: The mesh secures traffic without touching application code.
Identity comes from certificates, not IP addresses.
Canary by weight, roll back by weight.
